| module | text | yes |  |  | Slug of the owning module chapter (kb_chapters.slug), set only for kind=process rows; null for module/rule chapters. Populated by scripts/bible/sync.ts from each process chapter's frontmatter `module:` field. Deliberately not a foreign key: scripts/bible/sync.ts upserts modules and processes independently, one file at a time, with no ordering guarantee on a first sync against an empty table -- a FK could reject a valid process row upserted before its module row exists. Referential validity is instead checked in application code at the end of sync.ts, which fails loudly on a bad reference rather than being silently wrong. |

## rental_agreement_items

One physical serialized unit out on one rental. Scoped to serialized categories (LAP/DES/MON/TAB) -- fungible accessories have no asset_ledger row and are out of scope. This is where the unit<->rental link lives: a rent-charge `sales` row deliberately leaves asset_ledger_id NULL so the unit never reads as sold and its purchase cost is never charged as COGS against one month of rent.

## rental_agreements

One rental deal: a customer takes N units from ordinary sellable stock for a period. Rent is billed per billing_interval into real `sales` rows (sales.rental_agreement_id) -- there is no separate rental revenue ledger. Overdue is NEVER stored: it is derived from expected_return_date vs an item still on_rent. overdue_notified_at / billing_notified_at are cron dedup markers only, not status.
